scope: 104 non-physical sources referenced by the retained v24 effective water snapshot and land polygon-custody report, plus the selected OSM physical land archive. This is not a complete dependency inventory and does not establish source correctness or geographic approval. Overture water shards are checked separately by the physical rerun.
method: Authenticated R2 GET and SHA-256 and byte-count comparison against live Neon source catalog pins; OSM is additionally compared with the local archive and each run sidecar.

osm_land_archive.method: Fresh remote GET streamed and hashed; local ZIP hashed separately; each run sidecar and matching local ZIP member independently hashed. The rasterizer read extracted local sidecars, not the R2 ZIP. SHA-256 collision resistance links the identical ZIP bytes.
